close_all: No pre-market close. All positions are held in accordance with hostage policy: collateral is already segregated per layer and rollover does not consume free equity.
hostage_policy: Use RP notional 2500, collateral 2500. Split into up to 4 layers of 625 notional each. Risk per layer is $25 (1% of total collateral). No manual stop orders are allowed; each layer is isolated by its $625 collateral, liquidation is the only stop. Open only when a watchlist limit-buy trigger is traded through. If aggregate unrealized NAV of open layers is below -$100, pause new entries and wait. Do not exceed 4 concurrent layers. When all four slots are occupied, hold NAV(-) positions rather than cutting, because each layer's risk is already collateral-isolated; wait for take-profit or liquidation.
rationale: RP remains the same because the new week does not trigger reallocation (the only reallocation happens on Monday 00:00 UTC when all slots are empty). Last week's layers are all long and remain within their predefined take-profit target levels. The new watchlist keeps the same liquid majors near recent weekly lows, using limit entries lower than current prices to fade a possible pullback. With 4 slots occupied and free_equity 0.0, no new entries can be executed anyway, so this weekly plan is realistic: it only becomes actionable if an open layer closes via TP or liquidation before the week ends.

watchlist.exit: Take profit limit at 84500; if stop runs, layer is liquidated at collateral exhaustion.
